content_type.description: Pick the type that best matches what the user asked for.

content.description: For text/code: the real answer, using any real tool results you gathered. For image: a single JSON-encoded object string, exactly {"title": string, "points": [{"label": string, "detail": string}, ...2-5 items]} -- this is rendered as a real graphic, so it must be valid JSON with no extra text around it. For video/audio: a vivid caption describing what that media would show, since no generation model is connected yet.
